decisions.reason: Although the net price display plugin is well within our existing extension know-how, by 2022 it appears more like a standardized feature with limited differentiation, so we would reallocate effort to core shop work and newer developments.
The ERP system interface plugin builds directly on our strongest integration capabilities and supports the firm's multichannel direction, so our in-house R&D can continue to improve it commercially.

After the earlier consolidation of similar tracking tools, this remaining price comparison tracking plugin still fits our analytics and optimization knowledge base and is worth keeping while it delivers learnable, measurable client value.

The net price reporting plugin is close to our skills but less central to the firm's strategic growth path, so it is more efficient to discontinue it and shift resources to broader commerce and analytics development.
